review.rationale: Primary review of all 51 entries on the official Rochester ECE faculty, affiliated faculty, visiting/emeritus and research-scientist pages, reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit. 18 regular faculty and 16 affiliated professors with professorial rank are included; instructional-faculty (teaching-track) professors, lecturers, research-title affiliates, visiting and emeritus faculty, research scientists and one deceased dean emeritus are excluded.
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 51 directory entries.
